traceability.notes: All defined requirements and acceptance criteria for 009.0-DEV-MAINTENANCE-TOOLS are fully implemented and verified. The project provides programmatic maintenance helpers and a CLI (`traceability-maint`) to detect stale @story annotations, update them (including batch operations), verify annotation health, and generate human-readable and JSON reports. Behavior is thoroughly tested for correctness, error handling, safety, and performance on large workspaces. User-facing documentation (API reference and README) describes usage and options in detail, matching the actual implementation and tests.
